name: carry_shoulder_bag
text: Walking straight forward while gripping a shoulder bag strap at the right collarbone with the right hand. Right elbow bent down by the body. Left arm swings naturally down by the left thigh. Keep right hand at the strap and keep walking.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 右手保持在右锁骨前扶单肩包带，右肘下垂，左臂正常摆动；用通话走路的手位向下25厘米、向后6厘米作末端参考重新生成，未另交站姿版。
